tools.description: Read session scene, revision, dirty state and scene hash. Does not imply application in a live editor.
tools.name: scene_get

tools.description: Apply 1..128 scene edits atomically in session memory; validates hierarchy and components. remove removes subtree. Save explicitly.
tools.name: scene_apply

tools.description: Undo one atomic batch in memory.
tools.name: scene_undo

tools.description: Atomically save to the selected project's startup scene; refuse observed external changes.
tools.name: scene_save

tools.description: Render current unsaved session scene to PNG through Voxy/Metal. Returns inline image, scene hash and local path. Local OBJ only; offscreen, no live-window claim.
tools.name: scene_render
